assessment: The authors of this paper model the D61G mutation in the gene PTPN11 that encodes the protein-tyrosine phosphatase SHP2 in zebrafish, creating a model consistent with the human Noonan syndrome (NS), which is predisposed to juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) and myeloproliferative neoplasm (MPN)-like syndrome. The study nicely provides a new model that can be used as the basis for future studies in the field. Because the mutant variably displays phenotypes along a spectrum from NS to MPN, different researchers can choose to focus on this as they see fit.
